steps.en: Add a page in src/routes and, beside it, a load function for its data
steps.zh: 在 src/routes 加页面，旁边写给它取数的 load 函数

steps.en: Generates route types and server-renders the first visit, then its client router takes over
steps.zh: 生成路由类型，首次访问服务器渲染，之后客户端路由接管

steps.en: Pick an adapter for your deployment target in the Vite config
steps.zh: 在 Vite 配置里为部署目标选一个 adapter

steps.en: On build, compiles once, then the adapter reshapes output for Node, serverless, edge or static hosting
steps.zh: 构建时先编译一次，再由 adapter 改造成目标平台的产物

value.en: A server-rendered Svelte app with co-located data loading and forms that work without JavaScript, deployable anywhere an adapter exists
value.zh: 服务器渲染的 Svelte 应用：取数紧挨页面，表单无 JS 也能用，到处可部署
